about.title: About Me
about.description:
My name is Özer and I am 18 years old. I am currently studying Software Development at MBO Utrecht, where I am building a strong foundation in full-stack development.

I have experience working on both the front-end and back-end of web applications. On the front end, I focus on creating clean, responsive, and user-friendly interfaces, while on the back end I work with logic, APIs, and databases to build reliable and scalable solutions.

During my studies, I continuously improve my technical skills by working on projects, applying best practices, and learning new technologies. I am motivated, detail-oriented, and eager to gain practical experience in a professional development environment.
